appearance_facts.fact: At the 2010 x-position, the solid blue Gas marker is in the upper half of the plot, while the dashed red Coal marker is in the lower half.
The blue Gas line rises steadily through 2010, whereas the red Coal line has fallen sharply from its 2008 peak to a low level by 2010.
The left axis label is 'Coal' in blue text and the right axis label is 'Gas' in red text, which is visually inconsistent with the series colors used in the plot.
Blue circular markers are connected by a solid blue line; red square markers are connected by a dashed red line.
Small numeric annotations appear next to the blue Gas series: '2.46' near 2004 and '3.27' near 2009.
Small numeric annotations appear next to the red Coal series: '7.04' near 2004 and '5.48' near 2009.

printed_facts.fact: X-axis label is 'Year' with tick labels 2000, 2002, 2004, 2006, 2008, 2010, 2012, 2014.
Left axis is labeled 'Coal' (blue text); no numeric tick values are visible on this axis.
Right axis is labeled 'Gas' (red text); no numeric tick values are visible on this axis.
The blue Gas marker at 2010 sits high on the plot, above the red Coal marker at the same year.
The red Coal marker at 2010 sits low on the plot, below the blue Gas marker at the same year.
Gas series shows '2.46' around 2004 and '3.27' around 2009; no explicit numeric label is printed at the 2010 Gas point.
Coal series shows '7.04' around 2004 and '5.48' around 2009; no explicit numeric label is printed at the 2010 Coal point.

public_definitions: Task instruction: 'Use the residential resource consumption dashboard to compare Coal and Gas at the 2010 checkpoint, then route the resource with the larger 2010 residential consumption or demand level to priority residential supply follow-up.'
uncertain: No numeric tick values are printed on either the left (Coal) or right (Gas) axis, so absolute consumption/demand values at 2010 cannot be read directly; only relative vertical position is available.
The axis label colors (Coal in blue, Gas in red) conflict with the line/marker colors (blue line = Gas, red line = Coal), creating ambiguity about which axis corresponds to which series.
No explicit data label is printed at the 2010 point for either series; the 2010 comparison relies on relative marker height rather than a printed value.
